threebody.title: New periodic orbits of the planar Newtonian three-body problem
not_checked: Hristov, Hristova, Puzynin, Puzynina, Sharipov, Tukhliev 2021-2024 (arXiv:2111.10839, 2203.02793, 2308.16159; >12,000 equal-mass orbits, db2.fmi.uni-sofia.bg/3body)
Dmitrasinovic, Hudomal, Shibayama, Sugita 2018 (J. Phys. A 51, 315101; ~200 orbits) and Jankovic & Dmitrasinovic 2016
Li & Liao free-fall (2019) and 3D (2025) catalogs (different initial configurations)
orbits with nonzero angular momentum (Broucke, Henon, Hadjidemetriou families)
threebody.verification: float64 adaptive Dormand-Prince 8(5,3); return error |r(T)-r(0)|+|v(T)-v(0)| < 1e-8 at rtol 1e-13, < 1e-6 at rtol 1e-11, both runs agree to 1e-6; T must be the minimal period; E < 0
threebody.novelty: an orbit counts only if its canonical word matches no catalog entry AND no catalog entry has the same m3, T* = T|E|^1.5 and initial velocity. A score > 0 is a CANDIDATE new family relative to catalog.json (2060 literature entries), not a proof of novelty: see catalog.json 'not_included' for catalogs that were not checked.
threebody.caveats: float64 only (the literature uses multi-precision Clean Numerical Simulation for long unstable orbits); orbits that are too unstable to close to 1e-8 in float64 are rejected, which is conservative.
